topic: How to style pure linen so it doesn't look wrinkled by noon

post.hook: Tight fits wrinkle faster than you think.
post.caption:
Linen doesn’t betray you. Bad fit does.

Quick fix, go one step easier in the silhouette.
A relaxed linen shirt with straight trousers lets the fabric fall cleaner instead of pulling and bunching with every move.
If it’s hugging your shoulders, elbows, or waist, creases show up faster.

Style linen to drape, not cling. That’s the whole trick.

Link in bio 👇
@snitch

critic.top_fix: Show a visibly relaxed linen fit with clearer drape, not a sleeve-adjusting pose that reads tight.
Show an Indian model wearing a relaxed linen fit so the drape-versus-cling advice is visible.
